reviews.author: karthikeyan muruganandam
reviews.text:
Dear Viewers,

Greetings!!

I recently bought a shitzhu and in couple of days he got sick, I just went to a clinic in sharjah and the puppy was treated casually but not recovering. He become worst being a 3 months puppy. Again I went to an another clinic in sharjah and they ask me to board the puppy since he was vomiting continously and no improvement day by day as of I was paying much and no results and it's almost a week the puppy was in clinic and going worse. PUPPY WAS HELPLESS AND AS A OWNER I WAS UPSET, SOMEHOW I NEED TO SAVE THE PUPPY.

HERE YOU GO!!

I Checked nearby who is the experienced doctor for vets, I MET THE MAN OF HUMANITY AND A CARING PERSON AS AN INDIVIDUAL IN THIS PART OF WORLD. DR. TAMIM.

He started diagnosis with my puppy and immediately identified the cause of the decease and helped the puppy by taking care of his own interest even in Ramadan time. He boarded the puppy as per my request and saved the life of my puppy.

The staffs are like family members, who showed lots of love and respect towards me and the pet.

I addition I would say about AL Jawarah is Excellent service, reasonable fees, flexible time, expertise in profession, experienced Doctor, humble with respect people.

Dr. Tamim, it's a personal thanks to you on behalf of my puppy and my family.

Thank you for saving ones life...

Regards
Karthikeyan

reviews.author: Saba yousaf
reviews.text:
I want to share that about 5 weeks ago, my cat got hurt from grooming shop. I was running in the whole market in search of good clinic.
2 clinics ruined my cat leg. They were just after money and not caring at all. They will treat you as if you are nothing and just do the in a minute so we keep. Coming and paying.

Alhamdullilah luckily i entered this clinic, Dr Tamim treated her like a human. This is the clinic you can trust your pet with. Most important thing he is very concerned with pets pain.
He stiched my cats wound and kept treating her in follow up visits.
Best thing is that Dr treat your pet personally and gives best treatment and suggestions. I am so happy that my cat is healing now Alhamdullilah.
Thank you so much Doctor and the nurse is also really good.

reviews.author: ML Ch
reviews.text: Glad we’ve found Dr Tamim, he is a savior and by far the best Vet I have seen. Dr Tamim and his team are the true meaning of dedication and integrity. He is a blessing and cannot imagine consulting another vet for my cats.

reviews.author: Imad Jamal
reviews.text:
By the grace of Allah, our little one survived.
I would like to thank you, Dr. Tamim (Al Jawareh Vet); he stood by us with unmatched professionalism and care.
Our cat was really in critical condition. He explained everything gently, treated him urgently for almost 2 weeks, and never left us feeling alone in the process.
His medical judgment was spot on — he prescribed the right medication and gave accurate doses.
Instead of giving up, he gave us hope.
What truly touched us is how he treated our cat not just as a patient, but as a soul worth saving.
Thank you, doctor, for walking with us through this, with kindness, skill, and heart.
May Allah reward you for the lives you touch.

reviews.author: Perveez Saifuddin
reviews.text: Dr. Tamim is an outstanding Veterinarian whose strong love for the welfare of animals is evident in his daily practice. His assessments and diagnosis have always been accurate. This is not just our opinion but also that of many pet owners that we meet when we visit Al Jawareh Vet Clinic. He has been our vet of choice for more than 10 years for our 5 healthy cats who have grown up under his care. Thank you Dr. Tamim  and keep up the good work.
